BiblicalUsage: Stalwart is the word for a nation scattered and peeled, a people terrible from their beginning hitherto, a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled, and the same people bring a present to the LORD of hosts, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the terrible people as the ones God will still receive, because the present comes to Zion from the very nation the rivers spoiled.
